Commentary.Commentary: West Indies are looking tired already in the heat and will be eager to head back to the pavilion to rest. They will need to brace themselves to face the Pakistan spin attack. Do join us shortly for the run chase.

Samuel Badree was able to get the early breakthrough but the West Indians were not able to fully capitalise on it. They did well to restrict the runs but Pakistan found their feet and kept on adding runs to the scoreboard. Their death bowling was not as sharp though and their fielding left much to be desired. Brathwaite redeemed himself in this innings by taking a wicket and helped keep the run rate down.

Pakistan have successfully weathered the first innings. They were put in to bat first and did well playing in the dewy conditions. Babar Azam and Sharjeel Khan might have gotten out prematurely but a combined effort by Khalid Latif, Shoaib Malik and Sarfraz Ahmed has taken Pakistan to a respectable total of 160.
Slower ball outside off, Sarfraz camps back and cuts it to point for a single. Good over that from Bravo and with that PAKISTAN FINISH ON 160/4!
FOUR! Put away! Slower ball outside off, Sarfraz slog sweeps it through the mid-wicket gap which Malik failed to do it initially. A well struck boundary for the captain.
Slower ball outside off, Sarfraz camps back to cut it but is beaten. Dot ball.
Short ball around off, pulled to short fine leg where a diving stop keeps the batsmen to a single.
Umar Akmal to bat next.

OUT! Pollard takes a blinder! Fuller ball around off, Malik premeditates a slog sweep and plays it well. The ball goes in the deep towards Pollard, who runs and times his jump to perfection to take a brilliant catch at the mid-wicket fence. Shoaib departs after a fine knock.
Full ball on middle and leg, Sarfraz drills it to long on for a single.
Bravo back on.
The ball has taken the inside edge of the bat and goes down the leg side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Misfield and runs! Short ball around off, Ahmed pulls it and the deep fielder in square leg lets it through for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket. Brathwaite fumbles but Pakistan settle only for a single.

Run out chance missed! Yorker ball on middle and leg, Malik bunts it back to Taylor and sets off for a run. Taylor moves to his right and fires it at the striker's end. if that hit the stumps, he was a goner.
Short ball on middle and leg, Sarfraz pulls it but it goes on one bounce to the deep backward square leg fielder for a single.
A low full toss on the pads, Malik goes to play it down the ground but it goes off a bottom edge to backward square leg for a single.
Beaten! Tossed up ball outside off, Ahmed kneels to slog sweep it but is beaten.
Serves it a bit flighted ball around off, Ahmed bunts it to mid-wicket for two runs.
Loopy ball on the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for a brace.
Tosses up on off, punched to the off side for single.
50-run stand between Malik and Ahmed.

SIX! Downtown! Tossed up ball around off, Malik shimmies to the ball of the pitch and lofts it with the straight bat over long on for a gigantic maximum. Pure timing there from the veteran player, Malik!
Bowls it down the pads, Malik plays it to mid-wicket for a brace.
Narine back on.
A yorker in the blockhole of Sarfraz, he does well to negotiate it to mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Punished! Slower ball outside off, ample amount of time for Sarfraz as he pulls it with utmost power through mid-wicket for a well placed boundary.
A low full toss on the stumps, Malik looks to heave it but gets a bottom edge to third man for a single.
Wide! Hurls it down the leg side, Malik goes after it to flick it but misses. Nevertheless, wide given.
Length ball on middle and leg, Ahmed flicks it to long leg for a single.
Hurls it fuller on the pads, Malik nudges it to square leg for a single.
Wide! Wayward ball down the leg side, wide given by the umpire.
FOUR! Brilliant! Short ball on the leg side, Malik camps back and flicks it away to fine leg for a boundary to welcome Taylor.
Taylor back on.
Slower ball on the pads, Malik kneels to sweep it away but miscues it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball around off, Ahmed pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Hurls it full and  it is pulled to mid-wicket for another brace.
Slower ball in the blockhole, Ahmed miscues it to long on but manages a brace. Brilliant running there.
Slower ball outside off, Ahmed waits for it and goes hard at it. The ball goes off an inside edge to the keeper after couple of bounces.
Low full toss around off, Malik bunts it to mid-wicket for a single.
Bravo back on.
FOUR! What a way to end the over! Length ball outside off, Sarfraz steers it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Sarfraz goes to the off side and looks to sweep but fails to connect. Dot ball.
Length ball outside off, Malik steers it fine to third man for a single.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short ball around middle and off, Malik pulls it with ease through deep mid-wicket for a well placed boundary. Brilliant execution there by the veteran.
Short ball around off, Sarfraz pulls it without any second thoughts. The connection is not that good and as a result it falls just short of Bravo in the deep mid-wicket region. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Sarfraz plays it to covers for no runs.

Nearly leg before! Tossed up on the stumps, Ahmed looks to play it to the leg side and the ball takes an inside edge and hits his pads. There is a big appeal but the umpire has spotted the edge. The batsmen pick up a single.
FOUR! Smacked! Full outside off, lofted over mid off for a boundary.
Shorter ball on the stumps, punched through point for a single.
Flighted ball outside off, swept through square leg for a single.
Shorter ball around off, guided to backward point. An over eager throw at the striker's end and the batsmen are able to come back for a second
Floated outside off, swept through square leg. A fielder comes running in from mid-wicket and dives to save it and the batsmen get a couple.
Hurls a length ball around off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full ball on the stumps, played to the off side for a single.
Bowls it fuller around the stumps, it goes off an inside edge to the leg side for a single.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Serves it around of, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

That was almost a stumping! Serves it outside off, it spins away after pitching. Sarfraz is drawn forward and manages to keep his foot inside the crease after getting beaten. A half-hearted appeal is turned down.
Sarfraz Ahmed to bat next, replacing Latif.

OUT! RUN OUT! Latif has to go back!  Short ball outside off, Latif sweeps it to square leg and they scurry for a brace. The throw was fired from the deep to the keeper by Evin Lewis. Fletcher collects it just over the stumps and whips the bails off. The appeal was referred upstairs and the replays show that the batsman was well out of his crease. A hard fought innings comes to an end for Latif.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs against Latif.
Another googly outside off, Malik stays deep and works it to the leg side smartly for a single.
Floats it around off, Latif drives it to covers and Brathwaite does well to give only a single.
Wide! Bowls it down the leg side, a play and a miss. Wide given.
Googly on middle, Latif stays in his crease and defends it.
Narine back on.
Serves it full and wide outside off, Latif punches it to point for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Length ball outside off, Malik tries to reach out for it but misses.
FOUR! Vintage shot! Full ball on middle and leg, Malik shimmies down the track and drives it through covers for a lightning fast boundary.
Short ball outside off, Latif premeditated a pull shot and gets a bottom edge to long on for a single.
A good length ball around off, Malik steers it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Latif stays deep in his crease and jams it past backward point for a racy boundary. Brilliant rotation of strike and then a boundary on the last ball.
Another slow full toss on the stumps, Malik was ever ready to work that to mid-wicket for an easy run. Pakistan setting the tone quite well here.
Full toss on middle and leg, a bit slower one. Latif manages it to play it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Edged and away! Short ball on middle and leg, it was well directed. Azam plays it awkwardly and manages a top edge to get a boundary over the keeper's head.
Short ball on middle and leg, Malik glances that fine to long leg for a single.
Full ball around off, Malik tries to run that fine but it falls off the thigh pad on the track. No runs.
Full ball outside off, cut to point for a single.
Leg bye! Length ball on the pads, Azam tries to run that fine but it falls to the leg side off the thigh pads. A quick run is taken as a leg bye.
Dropped! Short ball outside off, Malik stays deep and cuts it. The ball goes straight to Badree at point but he drops it. Poor effort and a single is taken.
Length ball outside off, Malik tries to cut at it but is beaten.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the off side for a single.
Shoaib Malik to bat next.

OUT! Brathwaite strikes on the very first ball! Short ball around off, Azam lofts it straightaway but it doesn't go miles. As a result, Pollard runs to his right from long on and takes it with glee. Brathwaite sends Azam off with his legendary send off. A good partnership stand is broken.
Carlos Brathwaite to bowl next.
FOUR! Flicked away! Fuller ball on the pads, Latif stays deep and flicks it instantly. The ball goes just over the deep square leg fielder and one bounce to the ropes.
50-run stand between Azam and Latif.
Length ball around off, driven to covers for a single.
Bowls it fuller on the stumps, Latif drives it to mid on for a single.
Short ball around off, Azam pulls it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Classical shot! Serves around off, Azam steers it classically through backward point for a boundary. Superb shot that.
A slow ball in the blockhole for Latif, he takes his own time and plays it to mid-wicket. There was some confusion about the second run but they settle for a single at the end.
Wide! Hurls it down the leg side, Latif goes for flick but misses. A wide is given though by the umpire.
Dwayne Bravo to bowl next.
Serves it on the pads, Latif plays it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Azam flicks it to mid on for an easy run.
Wide! What was that ball! Badree bowls it a bit quicker and it goes very wide outside off, wide signaled.
Floats it around off, Azam stays deep and pushes it to covers.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Latif slams it to mid on for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, the batsman stays deep and cuts it to covers.
Tossed up ball outside off, worked to the on side.
That was close! Serves it quicker and it stays low. The batsman does well to put bat to it.
Serves it a bit quicker and Latif nudges it to mid on for a run.
Quicker through the air and it is played to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Bowls it full around off, Azam shimmies to the pitch of the ball and lofts it. The ball takes an outside edge and goes through the gap in the covers. Two fielders race after it with Lewis diving early but they cannot stop it from crossing the ropes.
Floats it full around off, Azam punches it back to the bowler.
Serves it on middle and off, Latif with soft hands nudges it to the wide of mid on for a single.
Sunil Narine to bowl next.
Googly around off, Latif pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up on middle and off, Latif shimmies to the pitch of the ball and lofts it to mid-wicket for a brace.
loopy ball on middle and leg, Latif works it to mid-wicket for a brace.
On the stumps, pushed to mid on for a single.
Serves it on the pads, Latif looks to run that fine but is hit on the pads and it goes to the leg side for a leg bye.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Azam plays it to mid on for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Fuller on the pads, Latif tries to flick it but is hit on the pads. The ball goes flying to the fine leg fence via the pads for a boundary.
Fuller on the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR LEG BYES! Cheeky! Hurls it down the leg side, Latif after hitting that massive biggie does well to run it fine to long leg for boundary. Well, it came of the thigh pads though.
Edged! Length ball outside off, Azam kneels and slams it but it goes flying to third man for a single off the top edge.
Length ball outside off, Azam off his front foot tries to play but is beaten.
SIX! Massive! Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Latif shimmies to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over deep mid-wicket for a huge, huge maximum. That will release some pressure of him.
On middle and leg, played to mid on for a single.
Bowls it around off, Azam stays deep and steers it through third man for a brace. Great placement and execution by Babar Azam.
Serves it around middle and leg, blocked neatly.
Babar Azam to bat next.

OUT! Knocked him over! Tossed up ball outside off, Sharjeel charges ahead and Badree serves it wide outside off. Khan does well to put bat to the ball but it goes on to crash into the stumps via inside edge. An early breakthrough for West Indies. The dangerman departs!
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Sharjeel pulls it to square leg.
Perfect ball around off, it lures Latif for a drive and he obliges but is beaten yet again. Good over that from Taylor.
Full toss ball on the pads, Sharjeel flicks it nonchalantly through backward square leg for a single.
Length ball around off, Latif swings his bat hard and gets an edge to third man for a single.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Latif looks to poke at it but is beaten yet again.
A perfect length ball outside off, Latif strides forward and looks to defend but misses.
Short ball and wide outside off, it swings away after pitching. Latif goes chasing after it but misses.
Jerome Taylor to bowl from the other end.
Bowls it fuller on the stumps, Sharjeel goes for a pull but misses and the ball hits the pads. The LBW appeal is turned down instantly from the umpire.
Flighted ball on the stumps, Latif works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Latif tries to sweep it but misses and the ball hits his pads.
Short and wide outside off, Latif cuts it to point.
Starts with a floater on middle and leg, Sharjeel flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Sharjeel Khan and Khalid Latif will open for Pakistan. Samuel Badree will open with the bowling proceedings for West Indies. Here we go...

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed says that it is very different today as they are batting first. Adds that it is a good pitch today as it was yesterday. He is determined to win and the team has been developing. (On Amir's absence) Mohammad Amir will not be playing because of his recent marriage but the rest of the team is the same.

West Indies captain, Carlos Brathwaite says that they will have a bowl first as they have been very successful at chasing. Adds that yesterday, the ball became very wet and that they have spinner to restrict Pakistan to a decent target and chase it down. He claims that it may not be easy this time and adds that yesterday was a bad game. This time, he says, they will be a little more situational and continue to be an aggressive and exciting team and continue to play the game well. (On the pitch) He considers it a slow pitch with no demons in it. Reiterates that they didn't apply themselves earlier and this time will look to bowl and restrict them well and hopes the dew factor will help his side.
Toss - West Indies win the toss and choose to bowl.

West Indies weren't looking their sharpest in the humid climes yesterday but will have to cope better today as we are in for more of the same weather. With the slower pitch and more dewy track both sides will hope to bowl first. The toss will play a large factor today so join us shortly for it.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd T20I between Pakistan and West Indies. The results of yesterday's match took everyone by surprise. Pakistan won and by a huge 9-wicket margin to give the hosts a 1-0 lead. Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed has so far won both matches he has led and will be eager to add a third to his kitty. Windies captain Carlos Brathwaite, on the other hand, will look to even the scores.
